{{Citation}}
[[File:Plastoid.png|thumb|right|Plastoid]]
'''Plastoid''',<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> or '''plasarmor''', was the material used in the armor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and later in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. Plastoid tubing was often used to reinforce the walls of buildings.{{Fact}} Some of the structures in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] were made from this material.<ref name="ANH novel" />

The grip of [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries']] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] was made out of plastoid.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Plastoid was also used to produce sturdy chairs and other furniture, and even non-lethal slug rounds. These plastoid rounds were known to be used by the Republic's [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] for crowd control and situations where [[Death/Legends|killing]] was undesirable. One place where chairs manufactured of this material were found was on the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] ship [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']].

Plastoid was also used as a prosthetic material. [[Mirta Gev]] was one such user who used the material to repair her broken nose.
